title: Invertibility of the pinned single-module pullback comparison
statement: Choose shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. For any morphism f:X→Y of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and invertible O_Y-module M [def-sc-invertible-module], the specified left-derived counit used in the canonical pullback composition [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition], at M[0], followed by the termwise tensor-pullback single-complex identification and the unique adjunction-preserving tensor-to-ordinary pullback isomorphism [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], is an isomorphism Lf*(M[0])→(f*M)[0]. The canonicalSinglePullbackMap construction is the explicit composite, not an arbitrary chosen isomorphism.

source.place: Tags 06YD, 06YJ and 08HY; single-module specialization of bounded-above flat computation

proof.text: The chosen composition data supply an additive tensor pullback and a left-derived counit. Its single-module comparison satisfies IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison by construction. Apply the existing flat-module comparison theorem using the intrinsic flatness and quasi-coherence of an invertible module. Compose with the single embedding of the leftAdjointUniq isomorphism to ordinary pullback.
